field_principles.arc_branch_decision: Default-off unless admission, panel, selector, and live A/B gates pass with solve-neutral provenance.
field_principles.arc_registry_unchanged: Bare true when no artifact claims solve or registry credit.
field_principles.avoidable_orchestration_time_min: Approximate time spent in repeated failures and gate blocks.
field_principles.blocked_gate_task_ids: Conductor or gate-check blocks that did not run the science body.
field_principles.blocked_precondition_task_ids: Tasks whose own artifact reports a precondition block.
field_principles.canonical_artifact_hashes: Exact declared deliverable hashes and missing/malformed states.
field_principles.canonical_task_matrix: The fixed Exp5782-Exp5794 denominator with exact declared paths, conductor rows, artifact states, substrate, metrics, gates, retirement, and tests.
field_principles.conductor_outcomes: Latest conductor rows, retry counts, delivery failures, and gate blocks.
field_principles.constraint_branch_decision: Default-off unless stream, learning, transfer, and shadow integration gates all pass.
field_principles.criteria_matrix: Promotion and claim criteria evaluated without stronger public claims.
field_principles.docs_reconciled: The operator stop rule delegates ops/status, ops/changelog, and traceability edits.
field_principles.experiment_id: Conductor task id for this capstone.
field_principles.field_principles: One-line reason for every top-level field.
field_principles.gate_replay_receipts: Bare producer scalars and gate-check artifacts are replayed exactly.
field_principles.gate_skipped_agent_calls: Gate-block rows that avoided launching a science task body.
field_principles.gpu_cpu_receipts: GPU/offload and CPU/hardware receipts copied only as provenance.
field_principles.hardware_branch_decision: Cached hardware continuity cannot become speedup, energy, or production readiness.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal summary starting with complete: or blocked:.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Exact local artifact, conductor, gate, and document reconciliation only.
field_principles.missing_task_ids: Declared deliverables absent at their exact paths.
field_principles.negative_task_ids: Executed tasks with negative science or readiness-defect evidence.
field_principles.outcome_taxonomy: complete-positive, complete-null, complete-negative, blocked-precondition, blocked-gate, failed-delivery, missing, and retired stay distinct.
field_principles.phase_telemetry: Timings and retries support planning only, not scientific claims.
field_principles.positive_task_ids: Tasks with bounded positive infrastructure/control/hardware evidence.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Roadmap parses, hashes, resources, exact paths, and forbidden-file checks.
field_principles.prior_failure_retirement_receipts: Same-verdict retirements are named with manifest presence and scope.
field_principles.random_seed: Deterministic metadata for checksum stability; no stochastic science runs.
field_principles.research_complete_append_count: Zero because history append is delegated/unchanged in this focused run.
field_principles.result_path: Canonical deliverable path emitted by this workflow.
field_principles.retired_task_ids: Prior-failure task ids whose repeated verdict triggers narrow retirement accounting.
field_principles.retry_counts: Attempts beyond the first dispatch per task.
field_principles.run_date: Absolute capstone date from the operator prompt.
field_principles.schema: Versioned schema for this capstone artifact.
field_principles.scientific_null_task_ids: Executed tasks with valid null evidence, not gate blocks.
field_principles.slowest_tasks: Largest conductor window estimates for next-plan triage.
field_principles.solve_claim_count: Counts only explicit solve_claimed true fields.
field_principles.spec_refs: OpenSpec anchors for this artifact contract.
field_principles.specs_reconciled: This OpenSpec contract and test/module pair exist.
field_principles.status: Terminal state after exact input, protected-file, and schema checks.
field_principles.task_wall_times: Per-task conductor and artifact timing receipts.
field_principles.test_exit_codes: Observed command exits without relabeling failures.
field_principles.traceability_reconciled: False because traceability edits are delegated by the stop rule.
